local_review.finding_body: Review Signal #6 was violated in stats/io.micronaut/micronaut-core/5.0.0/stats.json: dynamicAccess was N/A, while resolved evidence described dynamic-access metadata and supplied no covered call sites, so the branch had no credible evidence that non-zero dynamic access exceeded 20%. Regenerating the report exposed 83 calls and only 10 covered (12.05%) before test expansion.
local_review.fix_note: Added the Netty common test dependency needed for Micronaut Core's tracked native-image build, added focused public-API tests for ReflectionUtils and ArrayUtils, and regenerated stats. Coverage is now 18/83 (21.6867%), and all coordinate validation, style, JVM, and native-image checks run in this review pass succeed.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the complete eventual PR diff and local evidence against Review Signals #1-#11. The change remains scoped to io.micronaut:micronaut-core:5.0.0, uses only reachability-metadata.json, has library-specific tests in a separate package with no native skip or target-version-pinned assertion, and does not trigger the metadata/dynamic-access mismatch rule. After repair, dynamic-access coverage is 18/83 (21.6867%), above the required 20%. The coordinate passes generateDynamicAccessCoverageReport, checkMetadataFiles, validateLibraryStats, validateIndexFiles, spotlessCheck, checkstyle, and the full JVM/native test task (15 tests). The resulting tree is approved.
